title: Erase the Mark, Preserve the Motion: Temporally Consistent Removal of Video Watermarks
title_zh: 【输入内容第一行翻译】抹去水印，保留运动：时间一致的视频水印去除

paragraphs.en: 文章提出PoseRegen框架，可在去除视频水印的同时保持内容与运动的时间一致性，揭示了现有视频水印的脆弱性。 Recent advances in video generation have increased the demand for reliable watermarking for copyright protection, yet the robustness of video watermarks against removal attacks remains underexplored. Most watermark-removal methods originate from the image domain: signal optimization injects imperceptible pixel-domain perturbations, whereas generative resynthesis produces a visually similar instance through diffusion synthesis. When extended to videos, the former introduces temporally varying noise that causes visible flickering, while the latter regenerates fine-grained structures inconsistently across frames, leading to structural motion inconsistency. To evaluate video watermark robustness, we propose PoseRegen, a pose-consistent reconstruction framework that removes watermarks while preserving the original content and motion. PoseRegen first applies a temporally shared viewpoint transformation to disrupt watermark-bearing spatial patterns and then jointly reconstructs the transformed sequence with a pose-conditioned video model. A frozen video DiT processes the complete sequence with its reference-video latent, and full-sequence Flow Matching supervision keeps identity and background consistent across frames. To further preserve motion structure, we introduce a lightweight Pose-Conditioned Motion Consistency Adapter that adapts the frozen backbone to temporally ordered pose guidance and constrains body-part trajectories throughout reconstruction. Experiments on eleven video watermarking schemes show that PoseRegen reduces the average bit accuracy to 0.505, near random guessing, while outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.34% on motion-related VBench metrics. These results reveal a practical vulnerability of current video watermarks and highlight the need to evaluate robustness jointly with temporal and motion quality.
paragraphs.zh: 文章提出PoseRegen框架，可在去除视频水印的同时保持内容与运动的时间一致性，揭示了现有视频水印的脆弱性。视频生成领域的最新进展增加了人们对可靠水印技术用于版权保护的需求，然而视频水印抵抗移除攻击的鲁棒性仍缺乏充分研究。 大多数水印移除方法源自图像领域：信号优化方法注入不可察觉的像素域扰动，而生成式重合成方法则通过扩散合成生成视觉上相似的实例。 当这些方法扩展到视频时，前者会引入随时间变化的噪声，导致明显的闪烁；后者则在各帧之间不一致地重新生成细粒度结构，造成结构性的运动不一致。 为了评估视频水印的鲁棒性，我们提出PoseRegen，这是一个姿态一致的重构框架，能够在保留原始内容和运动的同时去除水印。 PoseRegen首先应用一个在时间上共享的视角变换来破坏承载水印的空间模式，然后使用一个以姿态为条件的视频模型联合重构变换后的序列。 一个冻结的视频DiT利用其参考视频潜变量处理完整序列，全序列的流匹配（Flow Matching）监督保证了身份和背景在各帧之间的一致性。 为了进一步保持运动结构，我们引入了一个轻量级的姿态条件运动一致性适配器（Pose-Conditioned Motion Consistency Adapter），它使冻结的骨干网络能够适应按时间排序的姿态引导，并在整个重构过程中约束身体部位的轨迹。 在十一种视频水印方案上的实验表明，PoseRegen将平均比特准确率降低至0.505，接近随机猜测水平，同时在运动相关的VBench指标上超越最强基线9.34%。 这些结果揭示了当前视频水印的一个实际漏洞，并强调了需要将鲁棒性与时间和运动质量进行联合评估。
